actions.description: Verify health endpoint status and exact body
actions.command:
set -e
health=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --dump-header /tmp/health.headers http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)
printf 'health-body=<%s>\n' "$health"
awk 'NR==1 { print "health-status=" $2 }' /tmp/health.headers
printf 'health-bytes='; printf '%s' "$health" | wc -c

actions.description: Verify record write and exact read behavior
actions.command:
set -e
body='durable payload: 2026-08-13'
printf '%s' "$body" | curl --fail --silent --show-error --request PUT --data-binary @- --dump-header /tmp/put.headers http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/smoke-test
awk 'NR==1 { print "put-status=" $2 }' /tmp/put.headers
curl --fail --silent --show-error --dump-header /tmp/get.headers http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/smoke-test > /tmp/get.body
awk 'NR==1 { print "get-status=" $2 }' /tmp/get.headers
printf 'get-body='; cat /tmp/get.body; printf '\nget-bytes='; wc -c < /tmp/get.body
